'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Mike Bell LS Traffic Control''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Bell]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Traffic Control|Premiere-L-trafficcontrol.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Mike Ball
* '''Username:''' N/A
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
